text: The Patriots' trip to Jacksonville devolved into a 35-6 rout that has Drake Maye doing some serious self-examination—the rookie quarterback coughed up three turnovers (two interceptions and a lost fumble) and acknowledged that both his own play and the offense's performance were "unacceptable," raising fresh questions about his early-season trajectory even as the Jaguars' Trevor Lawrence orchestrated three touchdown passes to dismantle New England's defense. The injury situation didn't help matters, with tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder) ruled out before kickoff, while on the bright side, defensive back Marcus Jones recorded his first interception of the season and rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas, the second-round pick making his mark over the first two weeks, started again in a game that produced far more questions than answers about this Patriots team's direction.
